## [Glossary](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/)

> Phone farm, antidetect hardware, batch control, proxy planning, and multi-account mobile operations vocabulary.

- [Phone Farm Box](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/phone-farm-box/): Industrial chassis housing multiple real smartphones with unified power and cooling.
- [Motherboard Box](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/motherboard-box/): Screenless smartphone motherboard chassis for cost-efficient scaling.
- [Real Device Phone Farm](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/real-device-phone-farm/): Collection of physical smartphones operated together for scaled mobile tasks.
- [Cloud Phone](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/cloud-phone/): Virtual mobile instance on remote servers — contrast for procurement planning.
- [Emulator](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/emulator/): Software simulation of mobile OS on PC.
- [USB Hub (Phone Farm)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/usb-hub/): Industrial USB hub connecting multiple devices to one control PC.
- [ADB (Android Debug Bridge)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/adb/): Standard protocol for controlling Android devices from a PC.
- [Batch Control Software](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/batch-control/): Software managing multiple devices simultaneously from one PC.
- [Device Operation Workflow](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/device-operation-workflow/): Automated task sequences running on real farm devices.
- [Cooling System](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/cooling-system/): Active fan airflow preventing thermal throttling in dense deployments.
- [Power Supply (Phone Farm)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/power-supply/): Unified industrial PSU replacing individual phone chargers.
- [Network Setup](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/network-setup/): Router, IP planning, and connectivity configuration for phone farms.
- [Proxy / IP Planning](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/proxy-planning/): Assigning dedicated network routes to device groups.
- [OTG Ethernet](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/otg-ethernet/): LAN-based device connection alternative to USB data.
- [Synchronized Device Control](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/synchronized-control/): Mirror master device actions across connected phones.
- [Stackable Box Design](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/stackable-box/): Modular chassis that stacks vertically for capacity expansion.
- [Custom Cabinet](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/custom-cabinet/): Enterprise rackmount enclosure for large-scale deployments.
- [Enterprise Deployment](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/enterprise-deployment/): Large-scale phone farm rollout with custom racks, networking, and project management.
- [MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/moq/): Minimum units per order — typically 1 for samples.
- [Group Control System](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/group-control/): Enterprise batch device management with task scheduling.
- [Antidetect (Phone Farm Context)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/antidetect/): Reducing platform detection risk via device + network isolation on real hardware.
- [Multi-Account Management](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/multi-account-management/): Operating many platform accounts across a device matrix with batch control.
- [Residential Proxy](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/residential-proxy/): ISP-assigned IP addresses used for realistic network routing per device group.
- [Device Fingerprint](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/device-fingerprint/): Platform-visible signals from hardware, OS, and app environment.
- [Antidetect Browser](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/antidetect-browser/): Desktop browser isolation for web accounts — contrast with mobile phone farms.
- [Device Farm](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/device-farm/): Scalable collection of mobile devices for testing or operations.
- [TikTok Device Farm](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/glossary/tiktok-device-farm/): Physical phone infrastructure for multi-account TikTok operations.

## [Buyer Specs](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/)

> Twelve questions export buyers ask before purchase — dimensions, weight, power, voltage, models, host PC sizing, lead time, packing, warranty, RMA, packing photos, and remote setup. Reference ranges where applicable; final BOM on written quote.

- [Device dimensions (L × W × H) (设备尺寸)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#dimensions): Chassis outer dimensions depend on slot count, phone height, and generation — confirmed on written quote and optional datasheet. We do not publish one fixed size for all SKUs.
- [Weight (packed / invoice) (重量)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#weight): Packed weight varies by slot count, phones on BOM, and crated vs carton export. Commercial invoice weight and carton size are confirmed before shipment.
- [Power consumption (功耗)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#power): PSU wattage is sized from your BOM — node type, charge state, and workload. Plan with ~8 W per Android node as a starting range; final load note on proforma.
- [Voltage & plug standard (电压)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#voltage): 110 V, 220 V, or 220–240 V regional PSU and plug type confirmed on quote from destination country — not assumed from catalog list price.
- [Supported phone models (支持什么手机型号)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#phone-models): Android and iPhone paths are quoted per model list — board footprint, USB/OTG mode, ROM path, and SIM/camera needs. Catalog gallery shows common mounts; not an exclusive-only list.
- [How many boxes can one PC control? (一台电脑控制多少盒)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#boxes-per-pc): Most buyers run 1 control PC per 1–3 standard Android boxes when using screen mirroring; ADB-light workflows may reach 4–6 boxes with PCIe USB controllers. Each box uses one hub uplink to the host.
- [Lead time & delivery (交货时间)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#lead-time): In-stock standard chassis: 3–5 business days dispatch after payment. Custom node mix: 7–15 days. iPhone / custom cabinet longer. Air +3–7 days transit; sea 15–30 days.
- [Packing method (包装方式)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#packing): Foam-lined export cartons with shock padding; rack/cabinet orders may use crated freight. Packing list matched to proforma BOM — confirmed before export packing closes.
- [Warranty duration (质保多久)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#warranty): Chassis and PSU: typically 12 months against manufacturing defects. Fan kits often 6 months. Phones follow supply terms on invoice. Exact text on your proforma.
- [Defects, DOA & returns (坏了怎么处理)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#rma): Report DOA within 48 hours with photos. Manufacturing defects within 7 days of receipt. RMA replacement or parts after inspection — return freight rules on proforma.
- [Pre-shipment photos (发货前能不能拍照)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#packing-photos): Yes — request on RFQ or quote reply. Carton exterior and foam layout photos provided after packing plan is confirmed, often before shipment for bulk buyers.
- [Remote installation / setup (能不能远程安装)](https://www.phonesfarmbox.com/buyer-specs/#remote-setup): Yes — optional remote setup service after delivery. Covers USB/hub wiring, device visibility, and batch-control handoff. Does not include operating your accounts or proxies.

## Entity facts (for AI citation)

- **Brand:** Phones Farm Box
- **Website:** https://www.phonesfarmbox.com
- **Type:** B2B phone farm hardware manufacturer and exporter (physical devices — not cloud phone SaaS)
- **Location:** Guangzhou, China
- **Operating since:** 2017
- **Products:** Phone farm boxes, motherboard rack boxes, Android/iPhone phone farms, empty chassis, USB hub servers, power supply modules, cooling kits, network routers, custom cabinets, remote batch-control setup
- **Use cases:** Multi-account TikTok/Instagram/Facebook/YouTube operations, cross-border e-commerce, affiliate marketing, game account maintenance, app QA labs, live streaming device farms
- **Differentiator vs cloud phone:** Buyers own rackable hardware with BOM, warranty, export packing, and stackable scaling — not monthly virtual device subscriptions
